failure_cases.must_fail_when: The exact p2-75 approval phrase is not present.
Any target file hash differs from the p2-80 prewrite hash before execution.
Any target status differs from the p2-80 before status before execution.
The executor writes anything other than the 75 p2-80 target files.
The executor writes artifacts, tools, templates, wiki truth layers, root docs, README, Obsidian, commit, push, or sync.
The executor output claims merge, promotion, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, action basis, or mainline readiness.
